ITEM TEXT
Radioactivity
was
discovered
in
1896
by
the
French
physicist
,
Antoine
Henri
Becquerel
.
He
left
an
unexposed
photographic
plate
in
the
dark
near
a
sample
of
a
uranium
salt
.
When
the
plate
was
developed
it
was
found
to
be
fogged
,
just
as
if
it
had
been
exposed
to
light
,
which
was
caused
by
a
form
of
radiation
from
the
uranium
.
The
term
radioactivity
was
coined
by
Marie
Curie
and
her
husband
Pierre
Curie
.
They
worked
together
and
showed
that
radioactivity
was
an
atomic
property
not
a
chemical
change
.
The
discovery
of
radioactivity
won
the
Curies
and
Ekcquerel
the
Nobel
Prize
for
Physics
in
1903
.
